Reason: The band-like structure indicated by the arrows in Figure 1c represents a bronchial tube that has been displaced and stretched due to the growth of the adjacent cystic lesion (likely a congenital pulmonary airway malformation or similar cyst). This anatomical distortion is a known consequence of expanding intrathoracic masses pushing aside normal lung structures.
